_meta.description: Community boundaries for the 2023 Upper Tantallon study area, used to place a package's households in the community the emergency alerts name.
_meta.source: OpenStreetMap administrative boundary relations via the Overpass API, bbox 44.64,-63.94,44.81,-63.72
_meta.note: Halliburton Subdivision is the OSM name for the Haliburton Hills subdivision, which sits inside the Stillwater Lake community and is the name EA-3 uses.
